author: Hijacker2000
body:
Hello, I have been banned for advertising and I admit it was a wrong thing to do. I should have faced the consequences and I have for 1 year now. I've recently been getting back into Minecraft and I always had fun on this server. I know it was wrong but I'm asking you to accept my apology and let me back into the Avicus server. 
From: Hijacker2000

title: Appeal an Infration

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to appeal your infraction. Please don't advertise other servers in the future. If you're caught doing so, you'll have no chance of being appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
